tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark is the default theme; light is for documents, print and long reading.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and any surface that sits on `bg`.

tokens.name: bg-pine
tokens.usage: Quiet feature bands and secondary panels. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`, `accent`.

tokens.name: bg-navy
tokens.usage: Navigation bars and depth bands. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`, `accent`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px hairlines between sections and around cards. Never the only thing that marks a control; use `border-control` for that.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and tags. 3:1 or better on `bg` and `bg-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `bg-raised`, `bg-pine` and `bg-navy`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary and body copy on `bg`, `bg-raised`, `bg-pine` and `bg-navy`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Mono labels, captions, placeholders and metadata on `bg`, `bg-raised`, `bg-pine` and `bg-navy`. Not for body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal for links, eyebrows, current-page state and key figures when used as text or an icon on any surface. Never in the logo.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Decorative teal fills (cover, illustration, large blocks) in both themes. Do not set text in it on light surfaces; use `accent`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons. Text on it is always `on-action`.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons. Text on it is `on-action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action` and `action-hover`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: logo
tokens.usage: Logo ink that follows the theme: white on dark grounds, black on light grounds. The logo is only ever these two colours.

tokens.name: logo-white
tokens.usage: Logo on a fixed dark or mid-tone ground, such as `bg`, `bg-navy`, `action` or a photograph.

tokens.name: logo-black
tokens.usage: Logo on a fixed light ground, such as `bg` in the light theme or white paper.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warning status text and icons. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Error status text, icons and invalid-input borders. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: chart-teal
tokens.usage: First chart series and the highlighted value. 3:1 or better on `bg` and `bg-raised`.

tokens.name: chart-navy
tokens.usage: Second chart series. Lightened in the dark theme so it stays visible on `bg`.

tokens.name: chart-slate
tokens.usage: Third chart series and neutral comparison values.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headlines. One per page. Light weight, never bold.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Small headings, list titles, table headers.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Referral terms are shown on each deal.
styles.usage: Interface text, buttons, table cells, form messages.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags and metadata. Always uppercase, in `accent` or `ink-subtle`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input padding, small card gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gutters; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between content groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large panel padding; hero inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Minimum space between page sections; page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above and below a hero.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands, imagery and dividers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, cards, tables: the default corner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Large panels and media frames.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon container (rounded square) around the mark.
